config.label: Your LabelGrid API token
config.description: Your LabelGrid API token. Create one in your dashboard under Profile → API Tokens. Without it the server starts in setup mode and walks you through creating one.

config.label: Override the API base URL
config.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the production API.

config.label: Enable safe writes (create/update drafts, labels, artists, and similar)
config.description: Enable safe writes (create/update drafts, labels, artists, and similar). Enabled by default; set to false for read-only.

config.label: Enable full writes (distribution, takedowns, immutable uploads)
config.description: Enable full writes (distribution, takedowns, immutable uploads). Disabled by default; also requires LABELGRID_FULL_WRITES_ACK.

config.label: Must equal the exact acknowledgment sentence (see the README safety section) to arm full writes
config.description: Must equal the exact acknowledgment sentence (see the README safety section) to arm full writes.

config.label: Comma-separated subset of toolsets to expose (account, reference, catalog, releases, insights, finance, webhooks, distribution; pre-0
config.description: Comma-separated subset of toolsets to expose (account, reference, catalog, releases, insights, finance, webhooks, distribution; pre-0.3.0 names are accepted as aliases). Defaults to all except webhooks, which must be named explicitly to enable.

config.label: Force reads only; overrides both write flags
config.description: Force reads only; overrides both write flags. Defaults to false.
